logic.top_level: all (1 pain/disability AND 2 exam findings) AND one-of five pathways (advanced joint disease; AVN; inflammatory arthritis; revision; hip arthroplasty ANY: fracture, conversion)

k_of_n.quote: X-Ray findings should show at least ONE of the following

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate Exclusions section: infection of hip or bacteremia; skin infection; unstable angina; dementia that interferes with rehabilitation; lack of caregiver or unsuitable home; non-ambulatory at baseline.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision pathway separate; 'Conservative therapy is not indicated' for revision/fracture.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Total Hip Arthroplasty may be considered medically necessary ALL the following are met: 1) ... AND 2) ... AND ONE of the following:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Revision and fracture/conversion appear as options under the ONE-of list, so it is unclear whether pain/ADL (1) and ROM/gait (2) apply to them.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Hip Arthroplasty may be considered medically necessary if ANY of the following are present
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second 'ANY' header set at the same bullet level as the ONE-of list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Trial of at least 3 Physical Therapy sessions in the last 12 months OR documentation that either: Pain is so severe ...; OR Patient has severe functional limitations
BMI < 40: if BMI is > 40, optimization efforts must include ALL the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: BMI exactly 40 is unaddressed; ends with 'case-by-case' discretion

requirement_kinds.quote: Pain and functional disability that interferes with Activities of Daily Living (ADL's) due to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, avascular necrosis, or post-traumatic arthritis
Limited range of motion (ROM), antalgic gait, and pain with passive ROM on physical examination
Radiographic or imaging evidence in the last 12 months showing moderate to severe osteoarthritis ... Tonnis Grade 2 or 3
Continuous use of Anti-inflammatory medication for a minimum of 6 weeks, including BOTH acetaminophen and NSAIDs, unless contraindicated
Trial of at least 3 Physical Therapy sessions in the last 12 months OR documentation that pain is so severe PT is not possible
BMI < 40: if BMI is > 40, optimization efforts must include ... sustained weight loss over 3-6 months ... shared decision making
If diabetic the HbA1c < 7.5 (with the presence of heart disease, no specific A1c requirement)
Patient is actively followed by a Rheumatologist and has been judged to have exhausted non-surgical options including DMARDs
Aseptic loosening; synovitis; instability; peri-prosthetic fracture; mechanical failure or recall; infection; bone loss; dislocation; disabling pain with limb-length inequality or audible noise
Acute hip fracture by imaging (prior authorization not required when admitted through the emergency room)
Dementia that interferes with successful rehabilitation; Lack of caregiver or unsuitable home situation; non-ambulatory at baseline

thresholds.quote: BMI < 40: if BMI is > 40, optimization efforts must include ALL the following
at least 3 Physical Therapy sessions in the last 12 months
